hyperedges.label: Authorization model: JWT + RLS + app_users roles

nodes.label: Cloudflare Pages deploy workflow (GitHub Actions)
nodes.rationale: hit-panel's Pages project is Direct Upload (not Git-connected), so a push to main does not auto-deploy; this workflow builds and deploys to the existing hit-panel Pages project via wrangler on every push to main.

nodes.label: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN repo secret
nodes.rationale: token with 'Cloudflare Pages: Edit' on the Honchkrow1995 account; account ID is not sensitive.

nodes.label: status_rank column (ready-for-pickup sort)
nodes.rationale: 'Ready for pickup' default sort surfaces packages arrived in Nicaragua (en_destino) first and sinks delivered ones, oldest Miami reception as tiebreaker; backed by a status_rank column in the worker's schema.

nodes.label: HIT Cargo internal panel (hit-panel)
nodes.rationale: internal team dashboard to view all packages (Everest + Global Connection), filter/search, edit status manually, add internal tags/notes, and export reports; does not scrape Cargotrack nor hold the worker admin key.

nodes.label: hit-ever2 ingestion Worker
nodes.rationale: does the data ingestion (cron every 2h per provider + email trigger); the panel only consumes what the Worker writes.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Pages (static hosting)
nodes.rationale: static, no server or edge secrets.

nodes.label: Astro 6 + Preact + Tailwind stack
nodes.rationale: same brand tokens as the site (primary #FF3B3F).

nodes.label: Public /track tracker (minimal, no PII)
nodes.rationale: the panel is the internal twin of the minimal public /track; the panel shows full data (casillero, value, reference, sender) to authenticated team users.

nodes.label: Cargotrack (Everest + Global Connection)
nodes.rationale: the Worker (with admin key) is the only thing that scrapes Cargotrack; the panel never touches it.

nodes.label: Design: InsForge-direct + RLS, no own backend
nodes.rationale: panel talks to InsForge with the user's JWT and RLS decides per-role access: less code to maintain, real per-user auth, and the future mobile app reuses the exact same Auth/roles/RLS.
nodes.norm_label: design: insforge-direct + rls, no own backend

nodes.label: Row Level Security (RLS)
nodes.rationale: authorization lives in the database (RLS + RPCs), not in the client, so any new frontend inherits security and rules without duplicating them.

nodes.label: Design: writes via SECURITY DEFINER RPCs, not direct UPDATE/INSERT
nodes.rationale: staff has no write policies on tables; controlled functions validate the role and touch only allowed columns, so a client cannot manipulate columns it should not.
nodes.norm_label: design: writes via security definer rpcs, not direct update/insert

nodes.label: Design: 100% client-side static (client:only) on Cloudflare Pages
nodes.rationale: no server or edge secrets; the anon key is public by design and the real security lives in RLS + JWT.
nodes.norm_label: design: 100% client-side static (client:only) on cloudflare pages

nodes.label: InsForge Auth (email+password to JWT)
nodes.rationale: signInWithPassword returns a JWT (access token) the SDK attaches to each request; JWT carries sub (=auth.users.id) exposed to RLS via auth.uid(); refresh uses an httpOnly cookie + CSRF.

nodes.label: app_users table (user to role)
nodes.rationale: a user in auth.users without an app_users row (or with active=false) cannot enter the panel; currentUser() returns null and the login shows. active=false cuts access without deleting the user.

nodes.label: staff_role enum (admin/staff/viewer)
nodes.rationale: admin can view/write/manage users; staff can view/write; viewer views only (UI hides actions, RPCs still require staff).

nodes.label: is_staff() SQL helper
nodes.rationale: SECURITY DEFINER to avoid RLS recursion when queried from policies; returns whether the current user is in app_users and active.

nodes.label: Cross-domain refresh cookie limitation
nodes.rationale: panel (*.pages.dev) and InsForge (*.insforge.app) are different domains so the refresh cookie is third-party; some browsers block it, so a hard reload may re-prompt login. Removed by aligning domains.

nodes.label: packages table
nodes.rationale: guia (almacen_id), tracking_number, status, manual_status, effective_status (generated), service, weight, pieces, offices, casillero, referencia_name, declared_value, dates, provider_id.

nodes.label: package_provider_notes table (from Cargotrack)
nodes.rationale: notes coming from Cargotrack, including RETIRADO.

nodes.label: package_tags / package_notes (internal)
nodes.rationale: internal HIT tags and notes.

nodes.label: effective_status generated column
nodes.rationale: coalesce(manual_status, status) stored; the status the client actually sees (manual override wins); indexed for fast filter/sort/index.

nodes.label: shipment_status enum
nodes.rationale: en_almacen, parcial, en_transito, en_destino, entregado, excepcion, desconocido.

nodes.label: set_manual_status RPC
nodes.rationale: SECURITY DEFINER, requires is_staff(); sets manual_status override with optional note.

nodes.label: add_package_tag RPC
nodes.rationale: SECURITY DEFINER, requires is_staff(); inserts into package_tags.

nodes.label: add_package_note RPC
nodes.rationale: SECURITY DEFINER, requires is_staff(); inserts into package_notes.

nodes.label: dashboard_stats RPC
nodes.rationale: aggregates for the Overview (totals, by status, by provider, last ingest); exact counts.

nodes.label: Panel migrations (dashboard-auth, effective-status) in hit-ever2
nodes.rationale: operation tables are created/filled by hit-ever2; the panel adds auth/roles + RLS + RPCs in two new migrations. Future schema changes always via migration, never editing prod by hand.

nodes.label: Seed admin user (admin@hit-cargo.com)
nodes.rationale: role admin with verified email, created in the initial seed; password delivered separately in gitignored ADMIN-CREDENTIALS.local.txt, rotate on first login.

nodes.label: User creation procedure (Auth account + app_users row)
nodes.rationale: a panel user is two things: an InsForge Auth account and an app_users row with role and active=true; without the row (or active=false) they cannot enter. Today it is a CLI operational procedure.
nodes.norm_label: user creation procedure (auth account + app_users row)

nodes.label: Overview KPIs + ingest health traffic-light
nodes.rationale: KPIs, pipeline by status, and per-provider ingest freshness (green <=6h, yellow <=24h, red >24h) to detect if the cron stopped bringing data.

nodes.label: Shipments table (search/filter/paginate)
nodes.rationale: central daily-work table: search by guia/carrier tracking/casillero (debounced), filters by provider/status/service/date range, sort, 25/page pagination.

nodes.label: CSV export (respects filters)
nodes.rationale: respects current filters, up to 2000 rows.

nodes.label: Shipment detail drawer
nodes.rationale: side panel with data, event timeline, provider notes, internal tags/notes, and staff/admin-only actions.

nodes.label: Manual status override action
nodes.rationale: writes manual_status with optional note recording who and when; the way to correct/force a status (e.g. mark Entregado when the provider does not reflect it by color).

nodes.label: Stale indicator (>10 days no event)
nodes.rationale: shows a warning badge when a package has >10 days without an event and is not delivered, to prioritize follow-up.

nodes.label: Reports view (status x provider, service, monthly)
nodes.rationale: status x provider matrix, by service, received-by-month, date-range recalculation, and 'Estados'/'Detallado' exports.
nodes.norm_label: reports view (status x provider, service, monthly)

nodes.label: Build-time PUBLIC_* env baked into bundle
nodes.rationale: panel is static so PUBLIC_INSFORGE_URL and PUBLIC_INSFORGE_ANON_KEY are baked into the bundle at compile time; rebuild if URL or anon key change before redeploying.
nodes.norm_label: build-time public_* env baked into bundle

nodes.label: Custom domain panel.hit-cargo.com (future)
nodes.rationale: aligning panel + InsForge under *.hit-cargo.com makes the refresh cookie first-party so the session persists cleanly across all browsers.

nodes.label: crypto builtin externalized (Vite note)
nodes.rationale: Vite externalizes the crypto builtin imported by @insforge/sdk; password login and reads/RPCs do not depend on it in the browser; if a crypto error appears use a shim/polyfill in astro.config.mjs.

nodes.label: Future mobile app (reuses same backend)
nodes.rationale: designed so a mobile app (team and/or customers) reuses the same InsForge Auth, roles/RLS, and RPCs without rewriting auth or permissions.

nodes.label: Mobile secure token storage (Keychain/Keystore)
nodes.rationale: mobile uses the non-web flow returning refreshToken in the body; store it in iOS Keychain / Android Keystore, never plaintext or logs; access token only in memory.

nodes.label: Future customer role + per-mailbox RLS
nodes.rationale: for end customers, add a customer<->mailbox relation and a customer role with RLS filtering packages by the user's mailbox/owner, exposing only safe fields via a view/RPC (minimal payload like the Worker's /track).

nodes.label: Public anon key (identifies project, authorizes nothing)
nodes.rationale: the anon key is public (baked into the bundle) and authorizes nothing by itself; real authorization is the user JWT + RLS.
nodes.norm_label: public anon key (identifies project, authorizes nothing)

nodes.label: Authorization = user JWT + RLS (default-deny)
nodes.rationale: RLS is default-deny (no policies for anon; authenticated only reads if is_staff()); even with the anon key, without a JWT of an active app_users user you see nothing.

nodes.label: InsForge admin API key (server-only, Worker only)
nodes.rationale: the admin key is full-access and bypasses RLS, so it lives only in the Worker (hit-ever2) and never in the panel.
nodes.norm_label: insforge admin api key (server-only, worker only)

nodes.label: Public/private surface separation
nodes.rationale: the public site uses the Worker (minimal payload, no PII); the panel with full data requires login; InsForge is never exposed to anon with data.

nodes.label: User management UI (roadmap)
nodes.rationale: admin-only in-panel create/invite, change role, activate/deactivate; RLS already allows it, only the screen is missing.

nodes.label: 'Refresh now' button (roadmap)
nodes.rationale: calls the Worker's POST /admin/packages/:guia/refresh to force a single-package re-scrape; admin-only because it hits Cargotrack live, not just reads the DB.

nodes.label: InsForge Edge Function proxy for ADMIN_SECRET
nodes.rationale: the Worker's /admin endpoint authenticates with ADMIN_SECRET (not the per-user JWT) so it cannot be called from the browser without exposing the secret; a server-side Edge Function validates the JWT/admin role and calls the Worker with ADMIN_SECRET server-side.
nodes.norm_label: insforge edge function proxy for admin_secret

nodes.label: Worker ADMIN_SECRET (shared secret)
nodes.rationale: a shared secret guarding the Worker's /admin/* routes; if it reached the browser anyone with devtools could trigger any /admin/* including a full backfill.

nodes.label: Per-guia refresh cooldown/rate-limit
nodes.rationale: a per-guia cooldown (e.g. 5 min) so the refresh button cannot loop and hammer Cargotrack (single session, footprint).

nodes.label: Audit log (panel_audit table, roadmap)
nodes.rationale: a panel_audit table (who, which RPC, which guia, when) written from the write RPCs to trace overrides/notes.

nodes.label: Security & correctness audit (July 2026)
nodes.rationale: audit of the internal panel: solid architecture (only anon key on client, RLS default-deny, writes via SECURITY DEFINER RPCs, no XSS sinks); found one real authorization hole (viewer could write) plus correctness fixes.

nodes.label: CSV formula-injection fix
nodes.rationale: esc() did not neutralize cells starting with = + - @ tab/CR; scraped Cargotrack text (names, offices) reaching the CSV could be an executable formula in Excel/Sheets. Fixed by prefixing ' to risky cells.

nodes.label: Date range off-by-one fix
nodes.rationale: 'until' used lte('received_at', date) vs midnight, dropping everything received that day (today's shipments vanished from lists/reports/exports); fixed to < next day (full day included).

nodes.label: Logout finally-clears-state fix
nodes.rationale: logout() did not clear state if signOut() failed, leaving the UI 'logged in'; a finally block now always clears state.

nodes.label: Viewer-could-write RLS hole (is_writer fix in hit-ever2)
nodes.rationale: HIGH: viewer role could write via console though the UI hid buttons; fix lives in hit-ever2 (migration fix-viewer-write-rls) adding is_writer() and re-guarding set_manual_status/add_package_tag/add_package_note; apply the migration to close the hole.
nodes.norm_label: viewer-could-write rls hole (is_writer fix in hit-ever2)

nodes.label: Reports/CSV silent row cap (EXPORT_CAP)
nodes.rationale: MED: reports truncate to 5000 rows (Shipments CSV 2000) with no notice; KPIs/charts/totals computed on capped rows.length -> silent undercount diverging from the exact dashboard_stats Total. Fix: move aggregations to a server-side RPC or show 'N of M' using the count header.
